tests_summary: 1982/1982 npm test green (0 failed, 0 skipped), measured on this tree by scripts/run-tests.mjs, which runs `node --test "tests/*.test.mjs"` and writes the counts it read from the runner's own summary block to jev-artifacts/test-measurement.json. The number is composed into this record from that file on every run, so it cannot outlive the suite it describes. The gates it covers: five pack facets' proof lines, the ledger's declared baseline resolving, one job writing only its own result, a non-passing recorded step cutting the run short, the live model pinned rather than aliased, one run described one way, and a run that never called the provider read as a configuration gap rather than a provider error. deploy:check stages the build clean.
ci_summary: This head: 1982/1982 tests, 232/232 browser smoke gates, prettier, seo, plan:check, check-chars, deploy:check and gate:byte-budgets green, CodeQL green, Jev report attached. Every count here is composed from the run that produced this record, and every stated fact about shipped bytes is checked against the tree by scripts/check-evidence-freshness.mjs, which fails the build if the record states a count or a stamp the tree contradicts. The jev-complete job runs on pull_request only, needs every gate job this workflow runs plus always() so a red gate still produces a record, and writes its evidence and report to runner temp storage so the checkout stays clean.

the `performance` facet line was REMOVED from the former JSON facet_evidence field, and is deliberately not replaced by a typed line. It was the only axis whose proof line was a hand-typed PROXY ('eager first-load JS is 786,390 bytes against the 790,000 budget') describing bytes rather than a measured first paint, and it went unread while a real Lighthouse measurement existed as a CI artifact. The Lighthouse gate (Q-02, P0.4) now composes this line from the run that measured it: the report declares facet_axes and a composed facet_line, and build-jev-evidence.mjs derives the axis from the gate reports, so the judge's numbers and the report's cannot drift apart. A missing report leaves the axis absent, which the judge reads as unverified and never as proven. tests/jev-derived-facets.test.mjs fails the build if a typed `performance` line returns to this file

the `experience` facet line was REMOVED from the former JSON facet_evidence field, on the same terms as `performance`. It was a sentence about TEST COVERAGE (30 of 153 smoke gates are battery-only) — a true fact about this repo and a statement about nothing a visitor ever touches. scripts/check-experience.mjs (P0.4) now drives the staged build through the nine-step journey, provokes the reachable errors, reads the empty surfaces, and sweeps the DOM for dictionary keys painted into the page; its report declares facet_axes and carries a composed facet_line. On its first walk it found two surfaces rendering their own i18n key and two error messages that named a failure with no way out — all inside a panel quick mode hides. A missing report leaves the axis absent, which is read as unverified and never as proven. tests/jev-derived-facets.test.mjs fails the build if a typed experience line returns
